## Problem

Describe the expected and observed behavior and its user impact.

## Reproduction

Provide minimal steps and synthetic inputs. Include the version or commit and
relevant browser/runtime versions. Redact private environment details.

## Evidence

Include only sanitized logs or screenshots needed to understand the defect.
Explain whether you can reproduce it consistently and any known workaround.

## Related issues

Link existing reports you searched before filing this one.
